title: Venture Deals
author: Brad Feld & Jason Mendelson
note: The standard plain-English walkthrough of a VC term sheet, clause by clause — a natural companion to this site's VC & startup deals Learn category.

title: The Intelligent Investor
author: Benjamin Graham
note: Not a legal text, but essential for the business-judgment side of deal work: how an investor actually thinks about value.

title: Getting to Yes
author: Roger Fisher & William Ury
note: The foundational negotiation text behind the interests-not-positions approach used in this site's negotiation exercises.

title: IndiaCorpLaw
author: NLSIU / contributing academics and practitioners
note: Deep, citation-careful commentary on Indian company law, securities law and M&A developments — a good habit to read regularly.

title: SEBI's own circulars and press releases
author: Securities and Exchange Board of India
note: Not a newsletter — but subscribing to SEBI's own releases is the single highest-signal way to catch a regulatory change before a secondary source explains it.

title: Bar & Bench
author: Bar & Bench
note: Daily Indian legal news, including deal and regulatory coverage — also one of this site's own News sources.

title: a16z Podcast
author: Andreessen Horowitz
note: Useful for the business and market context around the deals a VC lawyer works on, even where the legal detail is US-specific.

title: Corporate Finance
author: Jonathan Berk & Peter DeMarzo
note: A textbook, not a light read — but the reference most worth having on the shelf for the valuation and financial-statement literacy the Business Skills Learn category points toward.
